name: Bant
description: Bant is one of Alara's five shards, an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

summary.text: Bant is one of Alara's five shards, an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

bio.text: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards, and Esper invades the others.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: The latest event shows Bant's armies fighting the horrors crossing their borders, while a 2023 page mentions Estel being sent to Bant to warn the Knights of Bant.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Alara split into shards, Bant's martial traditions became ceremonial and ritualized.
timeline.quote: Over the years, Bant's armies became less martial and more ceremonial.

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jhess and Valeron, two nations of Bant, are at war.
timeline.quote: Jhess and Valeron, for instance, are currently at war

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Rafiq says even in single combat he is never alone.
timeline.quote: Even in single combat, I am never alone.

citation.text: Angelic Benediction (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth credits Akrasa's safety to those who put loyalty above glory.
timeline.quote: Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe.

citation.text: Guardians of Akrasa (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Wyhorn advises filling the sky with boulders against aven bandits.
timeline.quote: Aven bandits can be sly.

citation.text: Rockcaster Platoon (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of the Skyward Eye unwittingly stirs fear and mistrust across Bant for an evil force.
timeline.quote: The Order of the Skyward Eye does the bidding of an evil force, unwittingly stirring fear and mistrust across Bant in accordance with his plans.

citation.text: Knight of the Skyward Eye (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akrasa holds a yearly joust whose prize is an Akrasan sigil.
timeline.quote: Once a year, Akrasa holds a joust that draws knights and their leotaus from every nation on Bant.

citation.text: Kiss of the Amesha (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil on a knight-captain.
timeline.quote: Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty.

citation.text: Sigil Blessing (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A council of archmages enchants Bant so mortals who die conforming to its ideals reform as angels.
timeline.quote: Long ago, a council of archmages put a complex enchantment on Bant, allowing mortals who died on the shard to reform as angels.

citation.text: "Angel", section "Bant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asha defeats Malfegor, banishing him to Grixis, and leaves a sigil that kept Bant safe.
timeline.quote: she simply banished him to the Shard of Grixis

citation.text: "Angel", section "Bant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Long ago a council of archmages enchants Bant so that mortals who die there can reform as angels.
timeline.quote: Long ago, a council of archmages put a complex enchantment on Bant, allowing mortals who died on the shard to reform as angels.

citation.text: "Bant", section "Angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Archangel Asha, ruler of Bant, gives her life fighting the demon Malfegor; no angel assumes her title afterward.
timeline.quote: who gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor long ago

citation.text: "Bant", section "Angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gwafa Hazid destroys Giltspire Castle in Akrasa.
timeline.quote: which was destroyed by Gwafa Hazid

citation.text: "Bant", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth nurses the broken Ajani back to health.
timeline.quote: she nursed Ajani Goldmane back to health

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Grixis incursion Elspeth unleashes her full powers and revives her squire Aran.
timeline.quote: She cast aside all the rules of civil warfare that Bant cherished and unleashed her full powers, devastating her enemies and bringing Aran back to life.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth helps Rafiq kill Malfegor, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.
timeline.quote: she assisted Rafiq in killing Malfegor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bant forever changed, Elspeth planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: With a heavy heart, she planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The angels cast the demons out of Bant, ending tainted sigils.
timeline.quote: those went away when the angels cast the demons out of the plane

citation.work: An Angel's Eye View of Bant
citation.text: "An Angel's Eye View of Bant". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux merges the shards and Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya; Mayael is powerless to stop it.
timeline.quote: By the time Bant castles and Jund tar pits intruded in her verdant paradise, Mayael was powerless to stop it.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gwafa Hazid escapes punishment for not-quite-legal goods by persuading inspectors and rulers to look elsewhere.
timeline.quote: whenever any not-quite-legal goods find their way onto one of his many caravans, his head never finds its way into the pillory for it

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas recruits Gwafa Hazid as a minion for his master plan.
timeline.quote: which is exactly why Nicol Bolas reached out to him to serve as part of the dragon's master plan

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: Guided by the visions of the elvish prophet Mayael, the elves, the Nacatl, and the earthshaking behemoths of Naya march to war with its new neighbors.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bant's Blessed face Esper's metallic horrors and Naya's encroaching jungle, and the knight-captains find their ceremonial combat naive as massed armies fight.
timeline.quote: The angels seem powerless to enforce Bant's cherished law, and soldiers fall by the hundreds.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper's sphinxes decide war is the only recourse after their etherium gifts are spurned, and Esper mages go hunting carmot.
timeline.quote: The sphinxes decide that war is the only recourse

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Taric is lifted on new wings above Bant and finds earthly aspirations turned into heavenly resolve.
timeline.quote: As his new wings lifted him high above Bant, Taric felt his earthly aspirations transform into heavenly resolve.

citation.text: Asha's Favor (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Galo Aher falls to a blast of fire and the Order of the White Orchid forges a sigil in his likeness.
timeline.quote: A paragon of honor, Galo Aher fell to a blast of fire.

citation.text: Mark of Asylum (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The nations of Bant forget their war and unite against a common threat.
timeline.quote: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

citation.text: Martial Coup (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring protection and order in her absence.
timeline.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

citation.text: Sigil of the Empty Throne (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Outsiders invade Bant and its soldiers learn to value battle scars as much as sigils.
timeline.quote: As the outsiders invaded Bant, soldiers who once saw sigils as the highest marks of glory began to see the scars of battle as tokens of equal worth.

citation.text: Valiant Guard (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A parasitic strix, finding no food on Grixis's edges, turns to the skies of Bant.
timeline.quote: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

citation.text: Parasitic Strix (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Plowbeasts of Naya escape their harnesses and feed on the fields of Eos and Valeron.
timeline.quote: Plowbeasts of Naya escaped their harnesses in droves

citation.text: Vagrant Plowbeasts (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes in Elspeth's care on Bant.
timeline.quote: Ajani woke up in the care of Elspeth Tirel on Bant

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flood into Bant, and the Order of the Skyward Eye sows mistrust and panic.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flooded into Bant, creating havoc.

citation.text: "Bant", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Creatures from Grixis and Jund slaughter settlements and Bant's angels lose control as society collapses.
timeline.quote: The angels no longer could keep Bant under firm control

citation.text: "Bant", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bant's borders merge with the other shards until it becomes part of New Alara; its castles lie in ruin.
timeline.quote: Its borders merged more and more with the other shards until it became part of New Alara.

citation.text: "Bant", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Bant castle emerges through the terrain, intruding on a sea of Esper.
timeline.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bant barely touches black and red mana at the Conflux, yet Paragon of the Amesha uses it.
timeline.quote: At the time of the Conflux, Bant has barely come in contact with black mana (from Esper) and red mana (from Naya)

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor kills Asha, ruler of Bant's angels, during the splitting of Alara, leaving the throne empty.
timeline.quote: since she died at the hands of Malfegor during the splitting of Alara

citation.text: "The Vorthos Awards: Conflux Edition". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After the Conflux, the Order of the Reliquary is sent beyond Bant's borders to find Bant landmarks that emerged from other shards.
timeline.quote: After the Conflux their mission changes

citation.text: "The Vorthos Awards: Conflux Edition". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas's minions in the Order of the Skyward Eye spread paranoia throughout Bant.
timeline.quote: Bolas's minions, the doomsayers from the Order of the Skyward Eye, spreading paranoia throughout Bant.

citation.text: "The Vorthos Awards: Conflux Edition". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column explains that the Conflux has so far physically overlapped only adjacent shards, so Esper's main conflicts are with Bant and Grixis.
timeline.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Crossing Bant, the knight recalls Sarkhan Vol and begins to have night-terrors of a dragon bursting from his body.
timeline.quote: They were night-terrors in which his body tore apart, revealing a fledgling dragon inside

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Refugees heading to the Sun-Dappled Court hear that a warrior-mage at Tower Stele destroyed an army of the hellish invaders and expect her to slay Thraximundar.
timeline.quote: A warrior-mage decimated an entire army of the hellish invaders !

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Balmgivers from Topa reach the refugees with food and healers, and Elspeth's name is spoken as Bant's hope.
timeline.quote: That night, the name Elspeth was spoken around campfires and inside healing tents.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The boy tells a blacksmith's family that Elspeth threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds.
timeline.quote: "She threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds," the boy replied.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Some Naya Nacatl join Bant and help defend the stone walls recently raised to keep Jund, Grixis and Esper out of Bant and Naya.
timeline.quote: helping defend the stone walls recently erected to keep Jund, Grixis, and Esper from encroaching on the sunnier lands of Bant and Naya

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Rafiq says a dead man's body belongs to Bant and his soul probably to the angels.
timeline.quote: His body belongs to Bant now.

citation.text: Offering to Asha (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A knight embraces all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant, though his former home calls him traitor.
timeline.quote: Let my former home call me traitor.

citation.text: Knight of New Alara (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jenara passes over wounded soldiers, her eyes on the foe.
timeline.quote: But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

citation.text: Jenara, Asura of War (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Naya elves journey through the rotting land of Grixis, and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, as examples of Alara Reborn's fusion of shards.
timeline.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Four planeswalkers pursue one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons.
timeline.quote: The four planeswalkers pursued one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lia makes a pebble crumble with magic.
timeline.quote: there was a popping noise, and the pebble crumbled on her knuckle.

citation.text: "The Stonekiller". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lia spots a spotted-fur creature watching from a tree.
timeline.quote: she glimpsed someone perched on a tree branch, hidden among the leaves.

citation.text: "The Stonekiller". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux reshaped Bant, raising an unnatural mountain range.
timeline.quote: An unnatural mountain range had clawed its way out of the earth and forever blocked passage to the sea.

citation.text: "The Stonekiller". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund

citation.text: "Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret warns Rafiq to employ the angels against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret sent a warning message to Rafiq

citation.text: "Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alara is struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Naya's forces march out of the jungle searching for answers to the Anima's visions, and Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.
timeline.quote: And the armies of Bant clash with the horrors swarming over their borders, defending their homeland in the name of their guardian angels.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: protected by innumerable knightly orders, warrior angels, and a caste system

citation.text: "An Angel's Eye View of Bant". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Leotau are steeds ridden by knights of Bant.
relations.quote: The leotau (LEE-oh-tow, last syllable rhymes with "brow") are the mighty lionlike steeds ridden by many knights of Bant.

citation.work: An Angel's Eye View of Bant
citation.text: "An Angel's Eye View of Bant". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: Gwafa Hazid is a human being of Bant.

citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: the bonds she's forged with her fellow knights there

citation.text: "Planeswalking into Conflict". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: adopted it as her new home plane
relations.quote: Elspeth had adopted Bant as her new home plane

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas

relations.quote: Before we saw them in Bant

relations.quote: That's part of why Elspeth has such a fierce instinct to protect the peoples of Bant.

citation.text: "Planeswalker Potpourri". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Claimed Bant as her adopted homeland
relations.quote: Elspeth, the errant knight who claimed Bant as her adopted homeland

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Esper invades the other shards, and the shards' legions pummel one another.
relations.quote: At each front, the shards' legions pummel one another with powerful magics

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Evil from Grixis leaks into Bant as the Conflux takes effect.
relations.quote: how the effects of the Conflux can be seen as the evil from Grixis leaks in

citation.text: "Alara Reborn", section "Webcomics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A shard of Alara full of knights, paladins, battle angels and castles, divided into five nations under a caste system.

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The shard of angels and knights with a strict caste and sigil system of loyalty, honor and truth.

citation.text: Shards of Alara: card flavor text (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
